One of his main projects is the Clinic Portal — a multi-role Flutter app He built for managing a clinic. It has separate dashboards for Admin, Doctor, and Staff, with secure role-based navigation. He integrated Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore so everything is real-time and secure. The app handles appointment scheduling, patient history, and tracking of admitted patients. He also added interactive charts with fl_chart, PDF generation and printing, file sharing, and JazzCash payment support. It was a complete clinic management system designed to work smoothly on mobile (and web). You can find the code on his GitHub under the clinic repository.

He also built a Wallpaper App in Flutter. It's a clean, modern app focused on good UI and smooth experience. Users can browse wallpapers by category, save favorites, download them, and set them as wallpaper with one tap. He paid a lot of attention to responsive layouts and performance so it feels snappy on different devices.

On the machine learning side, He created a Student Performance Prediction model in Python. he took historical student data, did preprocessing and feature engineering, trained the model, and evaluated it so it could give clear insights about academic performance.
He built an end-to-end ETL pipeline in Python that extracts, cleans, and transforms structured datasets, then turns the cleaned data into useful insights for decision-making.

He has designed several database systems from scratch. He created ER diagrams and applied normalization for Library, Hospital, and University systems, and wrote efficient SQL queries for data manipulation, reporting, and analysis.
LUMINA is a C++ project where He explored systems-level programming and software architecture concepts. It's available on his GitHub.
He has also experimented with a social hub Flutter app and a simple backend API in JavaScript. His portfolio site is hosted at azeemuhammad.github.io.

Right now He is focusing on becoming stronger in full-stack development, advanced Flutter patterns, and practical AI/ML workflows. He is especially interested in Artificial Intelligence, Flutter mobile development, Machine Learning, and Clean Architecture.
